body:
⚡ Project: Lightning Mayhem Artifacts (Miles Morales Edition)
Overview
This custom Minecraft plugin introduces three high-tier, legendary artifacts inspired by the Spider-Verse. It features a high-security protocol to ensure each item is unique, uncopyable, and limited in availability.

The Legendary Artifacts
🔱 Sticker Bomb Trident: A high-tech weapon featuring "Domain Expansion" that slows and damages enemies in a massive radius.

🔨 Mayhem Mace: A very powerful weapon equiped with a "Boomerang Throw" ability.

🛡️ Kinetic Reflector: A 99% Science defense shield that triggers a Kinetic Burst, launching enemies 8 blocks away and 5 blocks into the air.

Security & Technical Features
NBT DNA Tagging: Every artifact is embedded with a secret is_artifact NBT tag. This prevents players from "faking" artifacts by simply renaming normal items in an anvil.

One-Time Crafting Protocol: Once a legendary item is crafted, its recipe is permanently deleted from the server session and saved as "claimed" in the config.yml.

Void Insurance System: If an artifact is destroyed by the void or lava, the plugin detects the loss of the unique NBT tag and restores the crafting recipe automatically.

Persistent Configuration: Uses a fail-safe YAML configuration to track artifact status across server restarts.
